visualCharacteristics.structure: label (+ optional description) + small icon on the right, red left border, whole tile links out
visualCharacteristics.notes: Source section.iconGrid (Follow us on /community; also /community/stem, /community/royalty-owners, teacher-stem-training-program). White tiles, two per row from tablet up; the section style (orange-gradient) supplies the background.

contentPattern: row per tile: [icon image] | [title, optional description paragraph, link paragraph]
reuseGuidance: Use for icon + label link tiles (source iconGrid, e.g. social 'Follow us' links). Not for photo cards (cards-topics, cards-business) or plain text link lists (cards-links).
